name: FormalMATH
description: FormalMATH is a large-scale Lean4 benchmark for formal mathematical reasoning, containing 5,560 formally verified problems from high-school Olympiad to undergraduate-level theorems across various math domains. It includes a human-in-the-loop autoformalization pipeline to reduce annotation costs and evaluates state-of-the-art LLM-based theorem provers.
reputation: A strong and recent formal theorem-proving benchmark that is gaining attention in the Lean4 and LLM theorem-proving communities.
notes: Includes a novel autoformalization pipeline combining LLMs and semantic verification; reveals domain bias and challenges in formal reasoning for current LLMs.
